The '''Modified Guardian Plasma Charger''' is a fixed Guardian weapon developed from Salvation's work for Azimuth Biotech. It applies an unusual pre-engineered combination of Overcharged and Focused modifications to the [[Guardian Plasma Charger]], producing considerably faster projectiles, greater damage, and higher armour piercing.<ref name="edcd">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/d0f20ca17805588d77c1978fff99a01280dc2d22/modules/hardpoints/guardian_plasma_charger.json EDCD Coriolis Data: Guardian Plasma Charger data], revision d0f20ca, accessed 16 September 2026.</ref><ref name="axi">[https://wiki.antixenoinitiative.com/en/weapons Anti-Xeno Initiative Wiki: Weapons], last edited 18 June 2026, accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

Only fixed Class 1D and Class 2B versions are available. This is a distinct pre-engineered module rather than an Engineering blueprint that commanders can apply to an ordinary Guardian Plasma Charger.

== Operation ==

The firing control charges one plasma projectile before release. Holding the trigger increases the shot's damage and distributor cost up to the full charge reached after approximately 1.8 seconds. A charged shot can be held while the commander waits for a firing opportunity.

Modified chargers retain the standard weapon's 1-kilometre damage-falloff start, but the Focused package raises projectile speed to approximately 6,000 metres per second and improves armour piercing. This makes leading a moving target substantially easier than with the ordinary charger's 1,200-metre-per-second projectile.<ref name="community-test">[https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/i-tested-the-new-modified-guardian-plasma-chargers-in-a-high-cz.592715/ Frontier Forums: I Tested the New Modified Guardian Plasma Chargers in a High CZ], 30 September 2021, accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

The weapon deals Guardian plasma damage useful against both human and Thargoid vessels. Its strongest anti-xeno role is rapidly dealing hull damage and exerting an Interceptor heart. Splash damage and the charged projectile's aiming requirements make precise heart shots less reliable than with a [[Guardian Gauss Cannon]], particularly if a near miss causes the heart to retract or the Interceptor to raise another shield.<ref name="axi" />

The Class 2 version is the stronger anti-xeno option. Community testing measured roughly 78 MJ from a fully charged Class 2 shot, compared with about 45 MJ for the ordinary fixed Class 2 charger at the time of testing.<ref name="community-test" /> Multiple chargers can deliver severe burst damage, but fully charging them imposes high power-distributor demand; a ship must be built and flown around that demand rather than judged only by the delay between releases.

Each Modified Guardian Plasma Charger occupies one slot under the ship's experimental-weapon limit. Weapon stabilisers can raise that limit, although power and distributor capacity usually determine how many chargers can be used effectively.<ref name="axi" />

== Acquisition ==

Modified Guardian Plasma Chargers are material-barter purchases from the Guardian Technology Broker at Prospect's Deep in the permit-locked Mbooni system. Azimuth Biotech established Prospect's Deep as the replacement supplier for modified Guardian weapons after Bright Sentinel was destroyed.<ref name="supplier">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/successful-mining-campaign-sustains-azimuth Elite Dangerous: Successful Mining Campaign Sustains Azimuth], 10 November 2022, accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

The transaction supplies one module. It does not permanently unlock the weapon for credit purchases, so every additional charger requires another material payment.<ref name="broker">[https://inara.cz/elite/techbroker/ INARA: Technology broker], accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

Access to Mbooni requires the system permit associated with Azimuth Biotech. Commanders who do not yet have access must earn that permit before travelling to Prospect's Deep.<ref name="axi" />

== Engineering and anti-Guardian fields ==

The supplied Overcharged and Focused package cannot be replaced with another ordinary weapon blueprint or restored after removal. It also prevents application of Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance. The modified charger therefore takes damage in an anti-Guardian field even though ordinary Guardian weapons can now receive that resistance modification.<ref name="axi" /><ref name="agzr">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/update-notes/4-0-18-07 Elite Dangerous Update 18.07 notes], 7 August 2024, accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

This limitation matters around Thargoid vessels and locations that project anti-Guardian fields. For those encounters, a resistant standard Guardian weapon or a human anti-xeno weapon may be more dependable.
